notes: `problemsServerId == cfg.id` failing (selected server changed since the in-memory set was populated) routes to `loadPersistedProblems(cfg)` (line 174, reads `{serverDir}/last_startup_result.json` -- same file `checkLastStartup`/`reopenStartupProblems` read). If disk also has nothing (`problems == nil` or `.isEmpty`, line 116's guard), the response is `problems: [], isSoftFail: false` (line 177) -- never an error, an empty list is the normal "no known problems" answer.
